items.title: Should You Buy Alphabet Stock For The Chips It Now Sells?
items.summary: Alphabet (GOOGL) stock has drifted, returning negative 6.8% over the past three months while the S&P 500 returned 3.6%. The strongest evidence for upside from here is not in the advertising business that pays the bills. It sits in a revenue line the company only began recognizing in the second quarter of 2026: TPU system sales, shipped into customers' own data centers.

items.title: Can Microsoft Stock Keep Earning Like This?
items.summary: Microsoft (MSFT) is coming off the most profitable stretch it has posted in years, and its stock trades at $493.95, about 92% of its 52-week high. Nothing here is broken. The risk is quieter than that. The spending that came with those margins is still climbing, and the company has already told shareholders what it expects that to do to fiscal 2027.
